correctness.rationale: Direct Heyting-chain implication and pseudocomplement calculations reduce mnc to three disjoint structural cases. I_diamond becomes the forbidden interval for diamond values based on the last box value. Stars-and-bars counts every case exactly. A decreasing-ratio bound (at most 1/3 after the top summand) justifies dominated convergence to 2/3. An independent brute-force evaluation of both axioms for all monotone operation pairs on n=2..6 agrees; separate dynamic-programming enumeration agrees through n=14. Assumes only the stated axioms, not optional extensions. Finite checks are corroboration of the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The count concerns a natural all-size family of algebraic expansions of three recently axiomatized, logically distinct intuitionistic modal systems. It gives a complete forbidden-band normal form rather than a single small-table computation, exact all-n counts of each semantics, and sharp limiting shares 1/4, 2/3 and 1/6. This quantifies the cost of two independently motivated logical interaction axioms on canonical finite Heyting chains and enables benchmark counts for finite algebra/model search. It does not claim novel axioms or a representation theorem.
